info.title: Spartial Polyclinic Foundation API
info.description: Full Spartial HMS API backed by the spartial_hms PostgreSQL schema (migrations 0001–0019). Every request runs in a transaction starting with sec.begin_request so row-level security and audit capture apply. Covers authentication and TOTP MFA, facilities/departments/service points, staff accounts, patients (identifiers, contacts, next of kin, consents, verifications, duplicate reviews and merge), clinical history (allergies, problems, history), appointments, telehealth, documents, encounters, queue, triage, nursing, consultations, diagnoses, procedures, follow-ups, laboratory/diagnostics, pharmacy, billing and insurance coverages, break-glass, privacy/governance, access reviews, dual-control approvals, management reports, communications and the audit trail. Timestamps are RFC3339 UTC.

post.description: Staff with a confirmed second factor receive a Challenge (no tokens, no cookie) and must call /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. Web requires an allowed Origin and sets a path-scoped HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie (Secure outside development/test). Mobile requests must have no Origin. Credentials are rate limited by direct peer IP and normalized email: 10 attempts per 15 minutes. No forwarded client IP is trusted. Access lifetime 15 minutes; session hard expiry 7 days.

Web uses cookie and exact allowed Origin; mobile sends refresh_token without Origin. Old access token is invalid immediately. Reusing a spent refresh token revokes its entire session, including the latest credentials. Clients must serialize refresh requests, with no automatic retry after ambiguous responses. Web sessions idle for fifteen minutes cannot refresh; mobile sessions retain the absolute seven-day lifetime.

post.description: Requires an assigned active facility. Durable key scoped by actor and patients.create; canonical normalized request hash; changed request returns 409. Replays the committed 201 payload. MRN, audit, outbox, and idempotency response commit in one transaction. Shared phone numbers accepted. Different keys intentionally create distinct registry entries; duplicate suggestions/merge remain pending.
